calculation_notes: Join panel records to active profiles by program_id. Include only closed FY2026 actual monthly records from 2026-04 through 2026-09, using 2026-04 to 2026-06 as baseline and 2026-07 to 2026-09 as analysis. Exclude forecast, subtotal, open/draft, prior-cycle, and inactive-profile rows. Compute gap volume, gap rate, gap-rate change, late-report rate per 1,000, finding rate per 1,000, and weighted min-max normalized score. Round displayed values to one decimal.
